notes.title: Rapier Reveal, Aerodynamics, and Asteroid Mining
notes.content:
Dear pilot,

I have a lot to share with you today!

First, I’m thrilled to unveil the first public screenshots of the Earth Alliance’s inaugural vessel: the [b]L-1550 Rapier[/b]. This light fighter offers an exciting glimpse into the Earth Alliance’s distinctive design language and unique ship-building philosophy. [b]BoxWeld has done a phenomenal job[/b] crafting an identity for the Earth Alliance that feels fresh while perfectly complementing the existing United Colony designs within the Hunternet universe.

[h2][url=https://www.picdrop.com/cpudreams/9rM8zpLiyQ]Visit the L-1550 Rapier screenshot gallery[/url][/h2]
[url=https://www.picdrop.com/cpudreams/9rM8zpLiyQ][img]https://indiegogo-media-prod-cld-res.cloudinary.com/image/upload/v1747087483/vd5tsnhuou3uuwfutisv.png[/img][/url]

In our last update, I discussed [b]the new aerodynamic flight model[/b] and how pleased I was with the results. At the time, I didn’t have any good footage to share, but I’ve since uploaded a video that showcases the new atmospheric combat on our official YouTube channel. I think you’ll enjoy seeing it in action.

[h2]New Aerodynamic Flight Model[/h2]
[previewyoutube=aeJOiR-RoDk;full][/previewyoutube]

Since then, I’ve been working closely with our talented team and community to bring our vision of hazardous asteroid mining to life. In Hunternet, asteroids aren’t just static objects. They’re dangerous, dynamic threats that careen through space and collide with each other, creating thrilling spaces in which to mine resources. They are central to the [b]mine → build → conquer[/b] gameplay loop we are building for our persistent universe, and the civil war between the Earth Alliance and the United Colonies.

Our first asteroid mining update video includes the initial version of [b]Ivan’s new asteroid destruction visual effects and materials[/b]. It also features [url=https://youtu.be/6Ox7XvQG3ks?feature=shared&t=366]a squadron battle that I highly recommend watching[/url]. It’s a strong showcase of the current state of space combat and demonstrates how dynamic asteroid fields can offer interesting tactical options, including the use of stealth and maneuvering advantages.

[h2]Asteroid Mining First Update[/h2]
[previewyoutube=6Ox7XvQG3ks;full][/previewyoutube]

In the upcoming playtests, [b]I’ll be iterating with our community on the mining mechanics.[/b] The focus will be on rewarding skilled flying and intelligent use of explosives. Highly capable miners will be crucial to faction logistics and will be valuable targets to defend or eliminate in the ongoing war.

On a personal note, I had to make an emergency trip this month to visit my family. My father, who is 94, has been going through a difficult time. Fortunately, he’s been improving, and I’m very grateful to be here to support him and my family during his recovery. [b]Thank you to everyone who reached out with well wishes.[/b] It means a lot to me.

That’s it for this update. I’m more excited than ever to be building Hunternet. I feel fortunate to have this opportunity to be working on it with our community. [b]The focus on low-level technical foundations in previous updates is paying off[/b], and I can’t wait to dive into the next major game mechanic after mining.

Thanks again for your continued support,
Fernando Z

notes.title: Death of a Space Carrier
notes.content:
Dear backer,

It's time for some Hunternet fireworks to celebrate the new year! Enjoy these clips from our weekly playtests showing various [b]stages of the carrier development process[/b]: 

[h2]Death of a Space Carrier[/h2]
[previewyoutube=TqE8p3qPu4I;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TqE8p3qPu4I[/previewyoutube]

The final video of the Hunternet Academy series has also gone live since my last update:

[h2]Introduction to the Hunternet Academy[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OuExCt5e_4w;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuExCt5e_4w[/previewyoutube]

[b]I've also added a proper aerodynamic flight model to Hunternet.[/b] You can test it in Jupiter's atmosphere at the Harvester Station test location or inside any Alien Nebula. It's an interesting mix of space and air combat that has been a joy to play test. 

This aerodynamics update also led to a complete rewrite of the SRM and LRM flight models and tracking. Missiles gained proper aerodynamic support and tracking is more consistent for both attackers and defenders while retaining missiles role as secondary tactical weapons.

Playtesting of aerodynamic combat also inspired improvements in non-atmospheric space combat. For example, coordinating your strafes and your turns will help you win a rate fight. [b]With these changes flight and close-quarters combat are better than ever, inside or outside of the atmosphere.[/b]

I hope you have had a great holiday and wish you a very happy new year!

Until next time, good hunting pilot,

Fernando Z

notes.title: Attention, commander on deck!
notes.content:
[h1]Attention, commander on deck![/h1]

Dear pilot,
 
We've been hard at work on carriers. For the first time you are now able to command and pilot Hunternet's carriers. These 1.5km behemoths and their 61 PDCs are your home away from home and together with their carrier born fighters and bombers they form the back bone of your factions war machine. 

The new [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaHLX4IaO_v9-6J48kXKGIzoBK0juvrAj]Hunternet Academy[/url] series also includes videos dedicated to commanding carriers and fighting them.

I'm including a carrier battle from one of our many carrier focused play tests. [b]This video features the new CVL-22 Artemis class light carrier by BoxWeld with pyrotechnics and thruster VFX by IvanGrozniy.[/b] They both continue to do an amazing job!

My main focus now will be getting asteroid mining ready for play testing. Mining will get us one step closer to the mine, build, and conquer loop that will be at the heart of the persistent universe.

Thanks again for your continued support. I'm more exited than ever to be working on Hunternet and can't wait to mine along side our play testers for the first time.

Until next time, good hunting pilot,

Fernando Z

notes.title: Initiate jump protocol and travel in Hunternet's test universe
notes.content:
[h1]Accelerate to 27,000 km/h in Hunternet's dangerously efficient jump gate network[/h1]

Dear pilot,
 
I'm happy to announce that [b]multi-location support is now live[/b] and with it the technical foundation needed to build Hunternet's new [url=https://hunternet.gg/planned-features/]open-world[/url] is complete. 
 
I've also implemented our first long-distance travel mechanic, [b]the jump gate network[/b]. BoxWeld and IvanGrozniy created the new beautiful jump gate art and helped refine this mechanic through their valuable feedback and ideas. Our community of brave test pilots has also risked their virtual lives to certify the jump gate network as ready for service.
 
In this video, I demonstrate travel between test locations via the new jump gate network. I also discuss plans for additional travel mechanics and a future update that will add static server meshing to Hunternet. 
 
[h2]Multi-location Update - Demo[/h2]
[previewyoutube=IK33GnOKd5A;full]https://youtu.be/IK33GnOKd5A[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Sneak peek of new territories[/h2]
[previewyoutube=fyXKNqpq6jA;full]https://youtu.be/fyXKNqpq6jA[/previewyoutube]

Now that the foundation for the open-world is in place [b]I will be focusing on open-world gameplay and art[/b]. Later, I will return to technical work to implement [b]static server meshing to ensure that Hunternet can expand seamlessly[/b] as the community and universe continue to grow.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/224812756581351425/1133191301660155986/S3.png[/img] 
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/224812756581351425/1133191302813601844/S0.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/224812756581351425/1133191303543398502/S2.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/224812756581351425/1133191302142509167/S7.png[/img]

In the short term, I will finish [b]integrating some additional VFX[/b] that IvanGrozniy has already created for us. His, recent weapon VFX and asteroid material updates are already live and are a feast for the eyes. I also plan on implementing [b]a special bounty-hunting hunting side-mission[/b] that will make your forays in the test universe more interesting.
 
[h2]New Hangar Preview - by BoxWeld[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/224812756581351425/1106846749001257051/hangar_preview2.jpg[/img]
 
Thank you pilot for your interest and support. Hunternet now rests on a solid foundation and I'm excited to build upon it, with the help of the startup team, our artists, and our community. Until the next update, stay frosty pilot.
 
Salute o7
Fernando Z

notes.title: Mask your sensor signature in the new test universe
notes.content:
[h1]Persistence successfully implemented, tested, and deployed in Hunternet[/h1]

Dear pilot,

Since the major networking update, I've been hard at work on the second technical update needed to support a [url=https://hunternet.gg/planned-features/]single shared persistent universe[/url]. I'm happy to share that [b]persistence is now live and you can try it out for yourself in the new test universe[/b]. But be careful, as promised, there are no safe zones and your ship's safety is your responsibility even while you are offline. The next technical update will be multi-location support. Once that is finished I'll be switching my focus back to gameplay and building the first open-world gameplay loops that these technical updates enable. 

While my focus was on making sure persistence was fast, reliable, flexible, and extensible, it has been quite fun to test even at this stage. Not knowing what to expect when I reconnect to a universe that lives on without me and hunting down weak sensor signatures as I attempt to dispatch the shutdown ships of my enemies before they return to the hunt has renewed my excitement for how game-changing a single shared persistent universe will be. 

[h2]Persistence Update - Demo[/h2]
[previewyoutube=fqcz0kM8uDI;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fqcz0kM8uDI[/previewyoutube]

Hunternet has continued to improve in other areas. I worked with Antonio on [b]a complete overhaul of cockpit ambiance and thruster sounds[/b]. The new implementation brings your ship to life with additional audio feedback for things like g-forces, damage, and thruster mechanics. I highly recommend jumping in and hearing this update for yourself. Next up in the audio redesign will be weapon and damage sound effects.

I also integrated a [b]significant set of graphical updates from Box for all existing starfighters and a new set of gun crosses for the HUD[/b]. Our ships' interiors and exteriors have never looked better and the new graphical damage effects provide great visual feedback. The HUD mechanics have also been further refined along with the graphical update.

Ivan's explosion effects are now even more satisfying and eye-catching with [b]new explosion details and physics-aware effects[/b]. Box captured this beautifully in his New Year's Fireworks video.

[h2]Hunternet - New Year's Fireworks[/h2]
[previewyoutube=EC-VfVUzlgU;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EC-VfVUzlgU[/previewyoutube]

The community also helped refine new race ring mechanics and some related updates to the flight model. This led to skramz being the first pilot to complete a sub-two-minute lap while also hitting speeds of over 1,300m/s.

[h2]Top Speed Demon - 01:59.368[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Vj-h1ASNaxo;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vj-h1ASNaxo&t=31s[/previewyoutube]

I also wanted to share with you two of my favorite clips from the weekly playtest since the big network update.

[h2]3 vs. 4 - Chickuns vs Ants[/h2]
[previewyoutube=3r791I1X7pQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3r791I1X7pQ[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Combat Racing - Ring Boost Testing[/h2]
[previewyoutube=g5Boezo1TAA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g5Boezo1TAA[/previewyoutube]

Until the next time pilot, I'll be hard at work on multi-location support. I want to encourage you once more to continue to spread the word, getting the word out is not easy and every little bit helps. I'm more excited than ever for the future of Hunternet and look forward to searching for and dispatching your ship in the universe.

Cheers,
Fernando Z

notes.title: One step closer to a shared universe!
notes.content:
[h1]One step closer to a shared universe![/h1]

Dear pilot,

Hunternet's [url=https://hunternet.gg/planned-features/]single shared persistent universe[/url] requires three major technical upgrades. Last Sunday, we successfully tested one of them. Improved networking with support for massive moving objects is now live. Next up are battlefield and war economy [b]persistence [/b]and unique location [b]instances [/b]with fast travel. 

[h2]Network Update - Demo[/h2]
[previewyoutube=oooyOhSoSK8;full]https://youtu.be/oooyOhSoSK8[/previewyoutube]

While I have been focused on these core updates, other parts of the game continue to progress. Our sound designer, [b]Antonio Coronato has begun work on the complete overhaul of Hunterent's sound design[/b]. His new alert and alarm sounds are already live. I'm working with him on cockpit ambiance next and you'll be able to preview them as they evolve.

[b]Ivan's new explosion effects have made each ship destroyed especially satisfying[/b]. His asteroid test materials are a big improvement and his works in progress show a ton of promise. We are lucky to have his support. 

[h2]New Explosion FX by IvanGrozniy[/h2]
[previewyoutube=iFhLLZFBrWQ;full]https://youtu.be/iFhLLZFBrWQ[/previewyoutube]

Behind the scenes, [b]Box continues to do amazing work on the next generation of location art[/b], ship updates, cargo containers, new carriers, hangars, and more. Our Galactic Wardens and Founding Orgs have seen some previews and I've included this sneak peek for all pilots. Thanks to Boxweld when the first universe location goes live not only will it be a big technical achievement but also an amazing sight to behold.

[h2]Unknown facility & resource containers by Boxweld[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40011135/55ba78e28dc258d336b29ca301bb221ad955ca1c.png[/img]

Other improvements since my last update include [b]fuel mechanics[/b], artificial nebulas, atmospheric drag for Harvester Station, the Legacy Fox's new [b]railgun[/b], dedicated Wingman instruments, improved salvage materials, and more.

That's it for now, dear pilot. I encourage you to join [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]our discord[/url] for more frequent updates and please continue to [b]spread the word it's a big help[/b] and much appreciated. Until next time, good hunting pilot!

Cheers,
Fernando Z

notes.title: Get your hard hat on Salvage comes to Hunternet!
notes.content:
[h1]Get your hard hat on Salvage comes to Hunternet![/h1]

Dear pilot,

One of the most exciting recent additions to Hunternet Starfighter is [b]our salvage gameplay loop[/b]. With the addition of physical wreckages for destroyed starfighters now comes the ability to salvage them for resources. 

In my many years of playing space and flight sims, I've been a combat focused pilot. Yet, thanks to the empahsis on core piloting skills and the significant room for impact, I have really enjoyed flying dedicated salvage builds. Skillfully executing cargo runs or mid flight resupplies has been really satisfying. This has me pumped for future salvage additions and asteroid mining.

To help demonstrate the new salvage mechanics, I recorded two new videos. These videos also showcase the iterative development process and the important role that our pilots play during our weekly playtest.

[h2]Part 1: How to Salvage[/h2]
[previewyoutube=NgMwxzRMfg0;full]https://youtu.be/NgMwxzRMfg0[/previewyoutube]
[h2]Part 2: Salvage 2nd Iteration[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Ql_2dnrx_7s;full]https://youtu.be/Ql_2dnrx_7s[/previewyoutube]

Thanks to the efforts of our community. This Sunday's playtest also marked [b]the debut of a new competitive leaderboard![/b] To join in on the competition drop by [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]our discord[/url].

That's it for today pilot, stay frosty and I'll see you between the stars!

o7
Fernando Z

notes.title: Hey listen! First public reveal of Saturn region's soundscape!
notes.content:
Dear pilot,

I'm excited to share with you [b]the first public reveal of a track from the Saturn Suite[/b] an original score composed by [url=https://soundcloud.com/william-dodson]William Dodson[/url] for the region around Saturn in the Hunternet Universe. 

[h3]Saturn Suite Soundscape - Composed by William Dodson[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Sezj4ow6y7E;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm very happy with how the suite turned out and I hope you enjoyed this preview as much as I did. I used some test footage I recorded with the first iteration of our spectator cam and set it to the Saturn soundscape. Will's track immediately elevated this simple video to another level. Will was a pleasure to work with and Ivan from our Startup Team deserves a lot of credit. He helped explain our vision for Hunternet and helped to direct Will, and it was a pleasure listening to them geek out on music. 

Since my last email, our community held a [b]Hunternet Big Guns Tournament[/b]. Some of our most talented pilots participated and the resulting videos are an absolute joy to watch. Congratulations once more to the victors but also to everyone who participated in this amazing display of space combat. Big thanks to the Chickun Squadron for organizing this competition!

[h3]Hunternet Big Guns Tournament - Matches[/h3]
[previewyoutube=7LZp-Uh7l_I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Hunternet Big Guns Tournament - Finals[/h3]
[previewyoutube=GxZqM5P0Kp0;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for today. Drop by [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]our discord[/url] and let me know how you liked the new soundscape. Until next time pilot, I wish you good hunting.

o7
Fernando Z

notes.title: Hunternet Starfighter, Tobii eye & head tracking launch!
notes.content:
Salute, pilot!

Tobii eye and head tracking is now available in Hunternet Starfighter!

After completing VR support Phase 1 I decided it was the perfect time to tackle Tobii support.

Tobii support phase 1 is now complete and I am very happy with how it turned out! Big thanks to Tobii for providing me with the hardware that made this possible. 

Head tracking feels smooth and natural and eye tracking adds something completely new to the sim. Eye tracking is an excellent fit for Hunternet's emphasis on using your Mark 1 eyeball to maintain situational awareness and for our intense close quarters combat. It works so well that I hope VR headsets with integrated eye tracking support become the standard in the near future.

Witness what this great bit a kit has to offer for us virtual space pilots:

[previewyoutube=DB8JxNUCSwY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you'd like to fly with us I highly recommend joining the official [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]Discord community[/url]. 

Good hunting pilot,
Fernando Z

notes.title: Hunternet Starfighter, now with VR support!
notes.content:
Greetings, pilot!

I'm happy to announce that Hunternet Starfighter now has VR support!

Last month I began work on VR support for the first time with a Quest 2 I purchased for the holidays. I wasn't sure what to expect as I was not a VR player before this. Simply put, Hunternet VR is amazing! It is now my preferred way to fly by far. I even had to add an in-game clock to the ship's HUD just to avoid losing track of time while in VR. The sense of scale and of inhabiting an actual spaceship has blown me away!

If you are a VR pilot, I highly recommend checking out Hunternet Starfighter in VR. I'm really happy I took the time to support VR and I look forward to hearing about your experience in Hunternet VR.

Phase 1 of VR is now complete and you can read the changes since the last devlog below. Phase 2 (the final VR phase) will come later when I begin work on a walkable 3D hangar. In the meantime the 2D main menu has been replaced in VR by a new VR-only main menu.

There really is no substitute to seeing for yourself in VR, but you can get some idea of what it is like in this new video I just posted:

[previewyoutube=7tDDUSZgCCY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you'd like to fly with us I highly recommend joining the official [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]Discord community[/url]. 

Good hunting pilot,
Fernando Z

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12/08/21 11:43 AM
notes.content:
Greetings, pilot o7 From now onward I plan to cross-post all patch notes from our [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]discord.gg/hunternet[/url] to Steam. These are the changes from our latest weekly play test (held every Sunday). Also included are changes from two minor updates published after the play test. I try to release an update once a week when possible so we have something new to test every Sunday. If you'd like to participate I highly recommend joining the official [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]Discord community[/url]. 

Good hunting pilot,
Fernando Z

- Improved performance of Black Corridor
- Baked Alt Speed & Ammo Factor
- Carrier SRS turrets now have reload logic, creating openings
- Fix: Scope reticle could become permanently hidden
- Fix: Disconnecting and entering main menu could mess up lighting
- Very long reload times for SRS and LRM
  - Cleaner reload logic, will increase reload times further if a problem
- Auto fixed reticle now visible while an LRM is in flight but not tracking
- Fix: Old Blue skybox had a visible seam that was removed by @[CHKUN] IvanGrozniy ❤️
- Fix: Spectator mode was overheating and playing heat SFX
- Fixed all glitches caused by flying far from location center
  - Critical for supporting multiple point of interest locations in the future
- Added new planet and moon skybox from @[CHKUN] IvanGrozniy ❤️
  - Will be adding a proper sun with flare in the future to our skyboxes
- Significant improvements to HDRP rendering performance
  - Will be a big help in hitting higher frame rates in VR
- Added high quality anti-aliasing support
  - Greatly reduced jaggies and also important for VR
- Added an optional toggle pip type button @=IDK=Dazegambler 
- Added an optional toggle auto targeting button @CMDR SmartAss 
- Added an optional mute audio button @SpiritGum
- Added another amazing new skybox by @[CHKUN] IvanGrozniy  to main menu ❤️
- Fix: Rendering of the lead ring was broken during optimizations @[SB] Zopto
- Added new track Gunslingers Tango by @Lamarro ❤️🤘
- Switched Primordium to use the new main menu skybox
  - how do you like it compared to the old nebula skybox?
- Improved Auto Targeting switching heuristics
- Auto Targeting will no longer switch targets while firing at visible target
- Adjusted Track IR translational sensitivity
- Added audio and message feedback to PIP and Targeting mode buttons
- Added subtle press and release SFX to SDS button @GrandDayOut
  - While not necessary was one of few actions that had no audio or
     visual feedback. Give yourself some time to get used to it but
     do let me know if you like or dislike the SFX @[CHKUN] Boxsoul @SpiritGum 
- Added: Ship menu > Cockpit > Theme > Radar Target Color: Allegiance or Border @[CHKUN] Boxsoul @(IDK) aCRAZEDgunman 
  - Default is now allegiance color (friend or foe color)
  - Previous behavior of using border color is also available
  - Fix: Lead ring was ignoring HUD off or auto settings

notes.title: Hunternet Starfighter - Free to Fly time extended until November 8th!
notes.content:
In order to give our players more time to secure their Steam crowdfunding keys I have extended our campaign and the free Demo here on Steam by 30 days. [b]You now have until November 8th to fly the latest version of Hunternet Starfighter completely free here on Steam.[/b]

Our crowdfunding campaign has [b]already reached over 100% of our goal[/b] and I am switching from a promotion focus back to a development focus starting next week. New updates will be released weekly and [b]the demo will always be the latest version[/b]. 

Take your starfighter up for a spin, and come fly with us between the stars!

[previewyoutube=u3a6o5PPMSE;full][/previewyoutube]

Pilot starfighters with simulated cockpits and advanced hardware control as you fight to avoid blackout in close-quarter maneuvering fights of man over machine. Take on your friends or form a squadron to take on one of our capital ships and their AI escorts. Try racing and see if you can make it into the exclusive 3-minute club on [url=https://discord.gg/hunternet]the official Discord[/url] or try your luck in a guns hot race. You have until November 8th. Good hunting pilot!

notes.title: Tournament Starts on the hour!
notes.content:
You and all your mates are invited to a major tournament today (October 3) at 1 PM New York time (7 PM Berlin Time). I will be hosting a series of Bounty Hunts (FFA) and Death Races, with teaming allowed. 

The pilots with the highest combined scores across all rounds will be rewarded prizes. Bring as many allies as you can to support your aces so that they can come out on top and claim victory. 

All rounds are drop-in and drop-out even mid-round. So even if you can't stay for the entire event you can still support any friends that are doing well to increase their chances of success.

We want as many pilots and streams as possible during this event. Let's make some noise and have some fun and celebrate the end of our crowdfunding campaign. Invite your friends for some epic fun while the free demo is still live on Steam!

notes.title: Hunternet Starfighter - Now on Indiegogo
notes.content:
We recently launched a crowdfunding campaign on Indiegogo. It is off to a great start and is already at 62% funded. This campaign will be funding improved art and audio and allow me to focus on the remaining core technical foundation so that our Early Access release is as smooth as possible. It's a great way to support us and to start flying with us right now. Thanks to everyone who has already backed us or has helped to spread the word. o7
